entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I need to return this useless VeloBand Cadence Sensor right now. I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault, or is it more of a preference issue?

I don't have time for a thousand questions! It doesn't do what I want. I don't like it. I want to return it. It's that simple. I'm looking at my order, and I got it a few weeks ago, so don't you dare tell me it's too late.
I understand your frustration, and I'm happy to check on the return eligibility for you. I just need to pull up your account. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes! It's VF-8675309. And I swear, if you try to give me some garbage excuse about your return policy or some nonsense about hygiene or sanitation, I'm going to speak to your manager and light up every review site on the internet.
Thank you for the order number. One moment while I review your details... Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 17 days ago, on December 15th.
And? Are you going to give me my money back or not? This shouldn't be this hard.

Sir, there's no problem at all. According to our policy, you're well within the return window. VeloFit offers a 90-day return period on the Cadence Sensor. I can start that process for you immediately.
Wait... what? Ninety days? You're not going to fight me on this?

No, sir. Not at all. You're well within the 90-day timeframe, so you are fully eligible for a refund. I've just generated a pre-paid return shipping label. I'm emailing that to the address on file right now. Do you still have the original packaging?
Oh. Uh, yeah. I still have the box. So I just ship it back and get my money?

That's correct. Just pack the VeloBand in its box, attach the label I've sent you, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Well... okay then. That's... surprisingly easy. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
